name: Geo Camera & GPS Stamp
tagline: Field documentation camera — original plus a separate GPS stamp
description: Geo Camera & GPS Stamp is an Android field documentation camera by MTC Code / Manoranjan. Capture a photograph, lock GPS when the device has a real fix, and write a separate stamped copy. The original is never overwritten. Missing GPS, altitude, or heading is labelled unavailable — never invented as 0. Core capture works offline. Package ID: dev.mtpcode.geocamera. Support: mtpcode.in@gmail.com.
features: Live camera with GPS stamp overlay (same painter as the saved copy)
Original JPEG is never overwritten — stamped output is always a new file
Honest GPS: unavailable values are labelled, never faked
Optional OpenStreetMap thumbnail and reverse-geocoded address
Projects, gallery, share, PDF report, and CSV export — kept free
Offline core: take a photo and save the original without a network
Banner ads on Home/Gallery only — never covering the shutter
Taking a geotagged photo does not require Pro

notes: Public product page and Play-ready privacy/terms URLs
On-device camera, GPS stamp overlay, compass, gallery, projects, share/PDF/CSV
